result: Accepted as a locally verified empirical Android runner change. No source-review blocker remains; actual emulator and full-native acceptance are pending.

priorFailure.observation: Authenticated completed job log establishes emulator PID6995 SIGSEGV with -gpu software; no crash stack or faulting component is retained.

rendererReview.finding: Official documentation describes software as adaptive selection and swiftshader as a supported software renderer for GLES and Vulkan. Selecting an explicit mode is a defensible empirical isolation step after the repeated host crash.
limits: No faulting component or proven crash cure is established.
Documented mode support does not prove complete feature equivalence or API35 acceptance. The actual installed binary must report its selected GLES/Vulkan backend on the next run.

The owner's current public upstream source review is not an attestation of installed emulator build16740729. This independent review relies on the documented mode contract and retains that binary-provenance limit.

collectorReview.sourceBinding: A single fresh regular emulator log identifies the actual launched PID, version and exact current-user/version crash-store path; eligible files are restricted to the launch/collection modification window.
protections: Directory-descriptor traversal and O_NOFOLLOW for source and destination; no arbitrary /tmp scan.
Current-user ownership and single-link regular files only; symlinks, hardlinks, FIFOs and other special files are rejected.
Fresh output directory is mandatory; preexisting output and symlinked log/output directories are rejected.
File identity, size, mtime and ctime are checked before/after copy; incomplete copies are deleted and never marked complete.
Read budget includes failed copies; entry budget includes skipped files/directories; copied/skipped entries and hashes are recorded.
limits: The store directory is version/user based, not a unique per-PID namespace. Current run binding relies on the one-emulator disposable workflow, logged PID and file time window; it does not prove the producer of every byte if unrelated emulators share that host/user.
The collector is best effort. Missing, partial, rejected or interrupted diagnostics cannot establish acceptance.
The five-second cooperative bound and outer timeout do not promise diagnostic retention after SIGKILL or external host destruction.

gateAndCancellationReview.ordinaryExitPreservation: Actual extracted cleanup preserves incoming exits0 and7 when the collector exits77.

cancellation.method: Execute the frozen actual cleanup block with fake ADB/collector commands and real isolated sleep processes; send SIGTERM to only the fixture process group.
limits: This is an actual-shell cancellation probe, not a GitHub cancellation or real emulator run.
The collector gate-exit argument is the incoming EXIT trap status. It can be zero during signal termination and does not establish the final process/workflow outcome.
SIGKILL cannot guarantee cleanup or diagnostic retention and was not claimed.

gateAndCancellationReview.interpretation: Both real process-group SIGTERM probes remain terminated by SIGTERM whether the collector returns0 or77. The incoming EXIT-trap status can nevertheless be0. The manifest field gateExitCode is raw cleanup-entry metadata, never a final process/workflow verdict.
gateAndCancellationReview.acceptanceAuthority: Existing mandatory navigation/capture exits, JUnit verification, movie decoder, full-app verifier and workflow conclusion remain authoritative.
